other_material_facts.value: The amount of Net Proceeds to be used for acquisitions will be based on our management’s decision and may not be the total value or cost of any such acquisitions but is expected to provide us with sufficient financial leverage to pursue such acquisitions.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: The actual acquisition will depend on number of factors, including the timing, nature, geographical and strategical location, size of acquisitions and other factors including but not limited to legal, operational and financial challenges, liabilities and the quality of asset to be undertaken and general factors affecting our results of operation, financial condition and access to capital.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: Another factor would be the organizational set-up i.e. if the proposed acquisition to be undertaken by purchase of assets and/or liabilities by way of the acquisition of shares of the target entity by our company.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: These factors will also determine the form of investment for these potential acquisitions, i.e., whether they will be directly done by our Company or whether these will be in the nature of asset or acquisitions or joint ventures.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: Acquisitions and inorganic growth initiatives may be undertaken as cash transactions, or be undertaken as share-based transactions, including share swaps, or a combination thereof.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: Acquisition process The acquisition process generally involves the identification of target acquisition based on the criteria identified by our Company, agreeing to commercial terms and signing the term sheet, entering into requisite non-disclosure agreements, carrying out the due diligence of the assets and liabilities of the company, sorting out the issues coming out of the due diligence process, signing the definitive share purchase agreement or asset purchase agreement, as applicable and finally the acquisition of shares and paying for the acquired assets.

other_material_facts.label: acquisition_investment
other_material_facts.value: However, the actual acquisition process may differ and depending upon the size of the acquisition.

other_material_facts.label: debt_repayment
other_material_facts.value: In the event that there is a shortfall of funds required for such acquisitions and/or strategic initiatives, such shortfall may be financed by surplus funds, if any, available in respect of the other purposes for which funds are being raised in this Issue and/or through, equity finance, debt, internal accruals or a combination thereof.

other_material_facts.label: general_corporate_purposes
other_material_facts.value: In the event that there is a surplus, such amounts shall be used for funding to other existing Objects of the Fresh Issue, if required, and towards general corporate purposes including meeting future growth requirements to the extent that the total amount to be utilized towards general corporate purposes will not exceed 25% of the Net Proceeds or such other amount in accordance with Regulation 7(2) of the SEBI ICDR Regulations. 5.

other_material_facts.label: general_corporate_purposes
other_material_facts.value: General Corporate Expenses Our Company, in accordance with the policies of our Board, will have flexibility in utilizing the proceeds earmarked for general corporate purposes.

other_material_facts.label: general_corporate_purposes
other_material_facts.value: We intend to deploy ₹[] Lakhs i.e. [] % of the Net Proceeds towards the general corporate purposes to drive our business growth.

other_material_facts.label: general_corporate_purposes
other_material_facts.value: The quantum of utilization of funds towards each of the above purposes will be determined by our Board based on the permissible amount actually available under the head “General Corporate Purposes” and the business requirements of our Company, from time to time.

other_material_facts.label: general_corporate_purposes
other_material_facts.value: We, in accordance with the policies of our Board, will have flexibility in utilizing the Net Proceeds for general corporate purposes, as mentioned above in any permissible manner.

other_material_facts.label: general_corporate_purposes
other_material_facts.value: Further, we confirm that the amount for general corporate purposes, as mentioned in this Draft Prospectus, shall not exceed 25% of the amount raised by our Company through this Issue or such other amount in accordance with Regulation 7(2) of the SEBI ICDR Regulations. 6.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: However, we may drawdown such amounts, as may be required, from an overdraft arrangement/cash credit facility with our lenders, to finance additional working capital needs until the completion of the Issue.

other_material_facts.label: working_capital
other_material_facts.value: Any amount that is drawdown from the overdraft arrangement/cash credit facility during this period to finance additional working capital needs will be repaid from the Net Proceeds.
